info.title: Epismo Public API
info.description: Language-neutral contract used by the Epismo CLI and external API clients.

get.description: The caller's work inbox. Requires OAuth. Public cases are not listed here; open them by id or rank them with GET /v1/cases/popular.

Ranks public cases that have a non-activity record. Ranking is currently distinct non-archived handoff destinations; scores stay internal and the weights may change. This is a homepage walk, not a complete catalogue. Pass playbookId to rank public cases of that playbook the same way. Works without authentication and is free. Always the public projection (no starter, assignee, or collaborator identities).

Pass the Case UUID or Case code (e.g. PANDA-317). Work collaborators receive the live case, tasks, the latest 5 records (newest first), and the handoff neighborhood. Public-only readers receive the live title, input, the latest 5 records, and readable handoffs. Follow recordsNextCursor with GET /v1/cases/{caseId}/records for older records.
Listing public playbooks works without authentication and is free. Supplying query runs metered relevance search and requires OAuth.

post.description: Any member of the connected Workspace may create a playbook owned by it. Members can read and edit workspace-owned playbooks; making them public and other access changes still require an Owner or Admin.

get.description: Returns the playbook along with its latest 5 suggestions (open, applied, or declined; newest first), recent versions, aliases, and up to 6 public cases that used it, bundled as one billable playbook read. Follow suggestionsNextCursor with GET /v1/playbooks/{playbookId}/suggestions for older suggestions, and casesNextCursor with GET /v1/cases/popular?playbookId={playbookId} for more example cases.

delete.description: Only a playbook owner can archive a version. The latest version cannot be archived.

get.description: Returns public/private visibility and explicit editors. Owners are implicit and are not editors.

put.description: Workspace members can read and edit workspace-owned playbooks. Only the owner (including Workspace Owners/Admins) can manage access, archive, and make a playbook public. Public grants published read access only.

patch.description: Any member may move a personally owned private playbook into the Workspace this request is connected to. A Workspace-owned playbook can only move to that Workspace's Owner or the playbook creator. Workspace-to-Workspace and User-to-User moves are rejected.

ownerId.description: User account you manage, or the Workspace this request is connected to. Any member of that Workspace may create a playbook owned by it; making it public and other access changes still require an Owner or Admin.

visibility.description: Public permits published reads only; it is not workspace-member visibility. Only an Owner or Admin can make a playbook public.

editors.description: Account or Team principal IDs that may edit content. Owners, and every member of a workspace-owned playbook, are implicit and omitted.

kind.description: Type of resource referenced by this step.

ref.description: Stable resource or container reference. For a GitHub-backed resource, use github:owner/repo and put any path inside the repository in selector.

selector.description: Optional location or pinned version within ref, such as skills/verification-before-completion or ^1. Do not use a default branch name such as main unless that specific branch is intentionally required.
